[[File:Arkanian_sonic_rifle.jpg|thumb|right|250px|An Arkanian sonic rifle.]]
The '''Arkanian sonic rifle''' was an [[Arkanian/Legends|Arkanian]]-manufactured [[sonic rifle]]. They were originally less fatal than typical [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], but because of low demand most were retrofitted to deal a large amount of damage.

==Behind the scenes==
The Arkanian sonic rifle was intended to appear in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]'' but it was removed from the final version of the game. As the weapon was still present in the game files, it could be obtained using cheat codes.
